---
title: "Basemap gallery"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Every basemap in the catalogue that needs no API key, rendered for the same
view of the San Francisco Bay Area. The names work as `style` anywhere: in `basemap()`,
`geom_basemap()`, `tm_basemap()` and in Python and Rust.

```{r}
library(basemapper)

p <- list_providers()
keyless <- p$name[is.na(p$api_key_env)]
length(keyless)

dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "gallery")
dir.create(dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (name in keyless) {
  m <- basemap(name, 340, 220, center = c(-122.25, 37.75), zoom = 9)
  render_png(m, path = file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".png")))
}
```

```{r gallery, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Lay out the images written above, with each one's name and form.
show_dir <- file.path(knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.path"), "gallery")
dir.create(show_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cells <- vapply(keyless, function(name) {
  file.copy(file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".png")), show_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
  row <- p[p$name == name, ]
  form <- if (row$vector) "vector" else "raster"
  sprintf('<figure class="bm-cell"><img src="%s/%s.png" alt="%s" loading="lazy"><figcaption><code>%s</code> <span>%s</span></figcaption></figure>',
          show_dir, name, name, name, form)
}, character(1))
cat('<div class="bm-gallery">', paste(cells, collapse = "\n"), "</div>", sep = "\n")
```

The vector basemaps (OpenFreeMap, and Esri's vector styles) are drawn from
vector tiles by basemapper's port of MapLibre GL JS; the raster ones are
tile images. Esri's names have both forms; `basemap_provider(name, type =
"raster")` picks the other one.

## With an API key

CARTO, Stadia Maps and MapTiler need a free API key, read from the
environment variable in `api_key_env` (or given as `api_key =` to
`basemap_provider()`):

```{r}
p[!is.na(p$api_key_env), c("name", "vector", "raster", "api_key_env")]
```
